_README: MSK cost attributable to THIS RUN (31.4h window), not the cluster's lifetime.
Broker-hours and EBS are deterministic from the cluster spec x uptime.
Cross-AZ is an ESTIMATE with stated assumptions -- it is the only uncertain line.
KEY: inter-broker (replication) cross-AZ traffic is FREE on MSK provisioned (AWS MSK FAQ:
'you will not be charged for data transfer within the cluster in a Region, including data
transfer between brokers'). Only CLIENT traffic crossing an AZ is billed. The AWS MSK Sizing
sheet's large 'Cross-AZ Data Transfer' line counts the free replication traffic and overstates cost.
Prices are us-east-1 reference; eu-west-2 runs 10-25% higher. Cost Explorer is authoritative.

client_cross_az.basis: ~4,300 GB (2/3 of 3,225 GB produce + same for consume) x $0.01/GB
client_cross_az.certainty: ESTIMATE - assumes 2/3 of client traffic crosses an AZ; rack-aware consumption could cut the consume half
